import awkward as ak


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor."""

    def object_preselection(self, events):
        """Select muons with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4."""
        muons = events.Muon
        good_muons = muons[(muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)]
        events["MuonGood"] = good_muons
        return events

    def count_objects(self, events):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event."""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events

from pocket_coffea.processor.base import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor."""

    def object_preselection(self, events):
        """Select muons with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4."""
        muons = events.Muon
        good_muons = muons[(muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)]
        events["MuonGood"] = good_muons
        return events

    def count_objects(self, events):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event."""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events
